title.narrative: Neighborhood Improvement Program II
Programa de Mejoramiento de Barrios II

description.narrative: Consistent with the objective of the Conditional Credit Line for Investment Loans (CCLIP) entitled Neighborhood Improvement Program (PMB), this Program maintains its objective of contributing to improving the living conditions of the population residing in irregular settlements and areas degraded, improving the access of households to basic infrastructure and adequate social and urban services

Consistente con el objetivo de la Lnea de Crdito Condicional para Prstamos de Inversin (CCLIP) intitulada programa de Mejoramiento de Barrios (PMB), el presente Programa mantiene su objeto de contribuir a mejorar las condiciones de vida de la poblacin residente en asentamientos irregulares y reas degradadas, mejorando el acceso de los hogares a la infraestructura bsica y servicios sociales y urbanos adecuados
